name: The Branch of Cenarius
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: Anilia puts her hands on your shoulders and draws you close. Gasping, she points towards the arch to the north, before her eyes close and her last wheezing breath leaves her body. "He has taken it... Geltharis..." You know in your heart that Anilia's dying wish is to see the Branch of Cenarius back in dryad hands.
narrative.objectives: Kill Geltharis and return the Branch of Cenarius to Illiyana at Forest Song.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Anilia died? No... that can't be! It was just yesterday that we were running and playing together in the woods.

I guess those days are over...
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you found them? What did Anilia say? Where is she?
